description: At a 1280x800 viewport (a common laptop screen size), once a vote is cast the diagnostic panel expands the card (8 reason buttons + optional textarea + Submit). The Submit button — the primary CTA to complete the comparison — falls below the fold and is not visible without scrolling. Confirmed by comparing two screenshots at different viewport sizes: at 1440x913 (the default agent-browser window) Submit fits on screen; at the standard 1280x800 test viewport it does not.
expected: Per rubric 'Layout Quality > Scroll necessity': no unnecessary scrolling for the primary task, i.e. Submit should stay reachable within a standard viewport once the diagnostic panel is open.
actual: Submit is pushed off-screen at 1280x800 after selecting a vote and opening the diagnostic panel; user must scroll down to find and click it.
suggested_fix: Tighten vertical spacing in the diagnostic panel, or make the reason-button grid more compact (e.g. smaller row gap, or a sticky/always-visible Submit) so the full flow fits without scrolling on ~800px-tall viewports.
